scientific_rules: Reuse matching existing designs after evidence refresh; do not count them as new molecules.
Construct exact precursor/product/new-bond pairs and deduplicate before announcing a molecule count.
Run source-backed practical route review before any new full redox campaign.
Do not assign two accessible electrons automatically: radical and ferrocene controls may support one; every path needs its own state/integrity checks.
Linker-constrained versus flexible structures should match attachment chemistry and approximate distance; record residual changes in formula, mass, polarity and conjugation.
Rigidification can increase persistent stacking; shielding can impede grafting or lower capacity. Test these effects rather than assuming improvements.
Compare anolytes and catholytes separately; no universal voltage maximization.
A shortlist requires every required axis to pass the declared acceptance criteria, including uncertainty/sensitivity. Pending evidence is not a pass or a chemical rejection.
A small all-axis panel establishes a focused scope, not exhaustive coverage of redox chemistry.

Evaluate declared redox/capacity/route/polymer criteria with field-specific QC
Take predeclared representative cases through the complete workflow and report failed/pending outcomes
